rationale: At 60 kW on a 100 kVA inverter the reactive capability is 80 kVAR. The low-voltage point injects 14.3 kVAR to raise 0.94 pu to about 0.95001 pu, the nominal point uses zero VAR, and the high-voltage point absorbs 28.6 kVAR to lower 1.07 pu to about 1.04998 pu. The q fractions are monotonic non-increasing with voltage and remain within capability.
